text.tspan: The labs in order: do each one right after its lesson
build and start the lab container
your IP, MAC, gateway, DNS and ports
namespaces, a cable, a switch, ARP
fix routing step by step; TTL, MTU
close, TIME_WAIT, DROP vs REJECT, UDP
your own root, TLD and auth servers
be a CA; untrusted, mismatch, expired
find and fix eight hidden faults
VLANs and 802.1Q · OSPF and BGP with FRR · a load balancer · nftables
WireGuard · an AWS VPC with a NAT gateway (may cost money)
